tive to any matter within the scope of its functions. It
shall also be empowered and authorized to request such
technical assistance as may be available from foreign
and international bodies, and to call upon any Depart-
ment, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of the
Government, including the corporations cwned and con-
trolled by the same, for such assistance as it may need in

The Commission shall submit its report and recommen-
dations not later than six months from the date of its
organization.
Done in the City of Manila, this Tth day of July, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight,
and of the Independence of the Philippines, the third.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
